item_short_desc: Comfortably swaddle your newborn in Rothco’s Infant Camo Receiving Blanket.
description: Comfortably swaddle your newborn in Rothco’s Infant Camo Receiving Blanket. This baby blanket is made from a soft and lightweight 100% thermal cotton material, perfect for keeping your newborn relaxed. This camouflage receiving blanket makes for a great baby shower gift, or present for your little one and can be used as a nursing cover, throw blanket, travel blanket and more. This camo receiving blanket measures 28 inches x 40 inches.
